source.title: Announcement of Four New Committee/Team Leaders
source.content:
Dear Community,

We are happy to announce that we have four new Committee/Team Leaders.

Hippolyte Moreau will lead the new WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) and Gregor Billing will lead the new WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC).

Lauren Clement will replace Linus Frész as the leader of WCA Communication Team (WCT) and Lorenzo Vigani Poli will replace Daniel Sheppard as the leader of the WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC). Both Lauren and Lorenzo were already working as a member of their respective committees.

In total we received 17 applications for the 4 positions. We appreciated the high turnout and the quality of the applications.

All new leaders were selected by the Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following our [Motion](https://docs.google.com/document/d/18DYu2WRrhtuwtd57BaE9kiYe9pFjQcX7rEVWjX2VhN0/edit) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Linus and Daniel for the great work they have done for the WCA, and wish the new leaders best of luck in fulfilling their new duties.

The new Leaders will be promoted immediately. The candidacy documents of those applicants willing to make them public can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1SYnFpxcxcVaUiIcAqT1NXy0Ln0cdXYlW) if you are interested in viewing them. 

Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol,
on behalf of the WCA Board of Directors
<!-- break -->

List of the other candidates who applied:

WCA Communication Team
* Hari Anirudh
* Joshua Beck
* Rui Reis

WCA Disciplinary Committee
* Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
* Claudio Gonzalez
* Sammy Tawakkol

WCA Ethics Committee
* Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
* Callum Goodyear
* Richard Patterson
* Ron van Bruchem
* Walker Welch

WCA Quality Assurance Committee
* Jacob Ambrose
* Saeed Mostafavi Layegh

translation.title: 四位委员会/团队新负责人任命公告
translation.content:
亲爱的社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，四位委员会/团队新负责人已获任命。

Hippolyte Moreau 将负责新成立的 WCA 道德委员会（WEC），Gregor Billing 将负责新成立的 WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）。

Lauren Clement 将接替 Linus Frész，担任 WCA 通讯组（WCT）负责人；Lorenzo Vigani Poli 将接替 Daniel Sheppard，担任 WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）负责人。Lauren 和 Lorenzo 此前已分别在各自团队中担任成员。

这四个职位共收到 17 份申请。感谢大家踊跃申请，申请材料的质量也令人欣喜。

所有新负责人均由董事会选定，并根据关于 WCA 委员会与团队的[决议](https://docs.google.com/document/d/18DYu2WRrhtuwtd57BaE9kiYe9pFjQcX7rEVWjX2VhN0/edit)，经现任委员会负责人及高级代表投票通过。

感谢 Linus 和 Daniel 为 WCA 所做的出色工作，也祝新负责人在新岗位上一切顺利。

新负责人将立即就任。愿意公开材料的申请人，其申请文件可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1SYnFpxcxcVaUiIcAqT1NXy0Ln0cdXYlW)查看。

Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol

代表 WCA 董事会

<!-- break -->

其他申请人名单：

* Hari Anirudh
* Joshua Beck
* Rui Reis

* Claudio Gonzalez
* Sammy Tawakkol

WCA 道德委员会

* Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
* Callum Goodyear
* Richard Patterson
* Ron van Bruchem
* Walker Welch

WCA 质量保证委员会

* Jacob Ambrose
* Saeed Mostafavi Layegh
